scope: Closed-world source allowlist. All base paths not listed are read-only. Every future source file must be listed exactly; draft globs confer no open-ended creation right. Evidence namespaces stay in each lane task card.

dispatch_amendments.B0: B0a creates only the explicitly listed shared contract declarations and inert initializers after CR0 APPROVE, before A2-A6/T0. Later B0 integration owns composition and shared tool wiring only; never edits any A1 Linux engine/store/reaper/RPC/retention/test path. Two B0 phases cannot overlap. All exact paths and test renames require amended cards.
dispatch_amendments.T0: CR0-07: amend T0 card to test_ prefixed paths listed in assignments (tests/platform/darwin/test_collection_contract.py, tests/scripts/test_macos_test_selection.py, tests/scripts/test_macos_collection_native.py); use default discovery and report exact node IDs. No custom collector or python_files change. B0 owns common fixtures/config only.
dispatch_amendments.all: Any extra file, dependency lock update, inventory output or fixture needs a fresh exact-path amendment and overlap proof; no inferred wildcard permission.
dispatch_amendments.A1: After CR0 APPROVE A1 may run concurrently with B0a, on the exact Linux engine/test paths. A1 owns the entire stop/store/reaper/RPC/retention repair. It can begin implementation from frozen declarations while B0a materializes them, but consumes the accepted B0a commit before seam/type/integration checks; it never writes shared contracts or initializers. R1/CR1 decides integrated Linux safety.

pairwise_non_overlap.method: Expand draft globs against git ls-tree BASE. Replace future globs with finite exact new-file lists. Check exact path and NFC+casefold identity uniqueness across all lane pairs; reject absolute paths, dot/dotdot components, symlink ancestors and file/directory prefix collisions. Revalidate canonical real paths at dispatch.

collection_policy.strategy: Every new native test uses test_*.py under existing testpaths=tests. No custom collection hook or python_files change. conftest.py and __init__.py remain support modules.
collection_policy.dispatch: Task Manager must amend old manifest globs and exact task-card selectors to these paths before writing begins. Old R0 case selector shapes are obligations, not leases; use these renamed files and preserve the case IDs.
collection_policy.verification: T0 records actual collected node IDs after modules exist; A0 only validates default discovery naming. No collection or runtime PASS is claimed for nonexistent product tests.

paths.src/binnacle/features/commands/stop_coor: Single executor/join state machine, prepare/resolution and terminal_guard implementation.
paths.src/binnacle/features/commands/job_store: Interprocess transaction, durable write barriers, guarded metadata/journal reads and deletion.
paths.src/binnacle/features/commands/job_owner: Owner routing, retry, recovery and terminal-return guards.
paths.src/binnacle/features/commands/jobs.py: Sole reaper, exit merge, job_state/list_jobs/await_exit, embedded stop route and spool retention.
paths.src/binnacle/features/commands/job_manag: RPC stop terminal guard before ok=true, singleton/restart fencing.
paths.src/binnacle/features/commands/job_clien: RPC error preservation and no unsafe retry/fallback.
paths.src/binnacle/features/commands/job_resou: Final merge and retention preserve unresolved evidence.

stop_path_responsibilities.linux_only_boundary: These files are the Linux durable engine, owner, store, reaper, RPC and retention implementation. B0 consumes their public methods read-only; Darwin composition never imports/routes through them. Shared command_backend/status consumers remain B0-owned and must preserve errors from guarded A1 APIs without reinterpreting terminal state.

freeze_authority: Revision 1.1.0 remains proposed until Supervisor re-reviews this exact signed commit and issues CR0 APPROVE.

contract_precursor_card.starts_after: CR0 APPROVE of exact signed 1.1.0 documentation commit
contract_precursor_card.scope: Shared declarations and inert package initializers only. No concrete adapters, service/process operations, composition/tool wiring, fixture behavior, source inventory, dependency changes or Linux engine edits. Preserve existing signatures and exports; additive frozen declarations only.
contract_precursor_card.A1_dependency: A1 may author in parallel from frozen seam text; accepted B0a commit is prerequisite to compiling/checking the shared seam. Do not duplicate declarations in A1.
evidence_only_checks: both platform mypy targets for touched source
contract_precursor_card.lease_rule: B0a and later B0 are sequential phases of the sole B0 writer, not two simultaneous owners.
